preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 30.
The size of X, n, must be between 1 and 100.
The number of sets m must be between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(m)])
preconditions.description: Each set Si must have a size vi between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, input().split()[1:]))) == vi for vi in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(m)])
preconditions.description: Each set Si must contain distinct integers between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of atoms k for each test case.
